code='''def transform(grid):
    # Encode T motifs by orientation in their coarse location.
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); out=[[0]*6 for _ in range(3)]
    seen=set()
    for r in range(h):
      for c in range(w):
        if grid[r][c]!=2: continue
        # horizontal bar centered c, stem one cell above or below
        for dr,val in [(-1,1),(1,3)]:
          if 0<=r+dr<h and c>0 and c+1<w and all(grid[r][x]==2 for x in (c-1,c,c+1)) and grid[r+dr][c]==2 and (r,c) not in seen:
            rr=min(2,round(r*2/max(1,h-1))); cc=min(2,round(c*2/max(1,w-1)))+(0 if val==3 else 3)
            out[rr][cc]=val; seen.add((r,c))
    return out
'''
p.write_text(code)
